<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net6.0</TargetFramework>
    <Platforms>x64</Platforms>
    <PlatformTarget>x64</PlatformTarget>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <AssemblyName>SprocketOscillatingTurret</AssemblyName>
    <RootNamespace>SprocketOscillatingTurret</RootNamespace>
    <Version>0.3.0</Version>
    <Authors>Nero</Authors>
    <Company>Nero</Company>
    <Copyright>Nero</Copyright>
    <Product>Sprocket Oscillating Turret</Product>
    <DebugType>none</DebugType>
    <DebugSymbols>false</DebugSymbols>
    <Deterministic>true</Deterministic>
    <PathMap>$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)=/SprocketOscillatingTurret/src</PathMap>
    <IncludeSourceRevisionInInformationalVersion>false</IncludeSourceRevisionInInformationalVersion>
    <AllowUnsafeBlocks>false</AllowUnsafeBlocks>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <PropertyGroup>
    <GameDir Condition="'$(GameDir)' == ''">C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Sprocket</GameDir>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Remove="tests\**\*.cs" />
    <Reference Include="$(GameDir)\BepInEx\core\*.dll"
               Exclude="$(GameDir)\BepInEx\core\TerraFX*.dll;$(GameDir)\BepInEx\core\dobby.dll"
               Private="false" />
    <Reference Include="$(GameDir)\BepInEx\interop\*.dll" Private="false" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- Heavy Trunnion Mount 0.3.0: picker icon inside the DLL; part JSONs and localization next to it in out\. -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <EmbeddedResource Include="..\model\heavy-trunnion-icon.png" LogicalName="heavy-trunnion-icon.png" />
    <None Update="parts\*.json" CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest" Link="%(Filename)%(Extension)" />
    <None Update="localization\*.xml" CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest" Link="%(Filename)%(Extension)" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

<Part xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <name>Heavy Trunnion Mount</name>
  <description>Heavy trunnions with an electric elevation motor and reduction gearbox. Twice the elevation torque of the standard trunnions, same top speed; adds 250 kg. Build the gun or a complete upper turret on the trunnions. Torque, mass and cost are set in the Sprocket Oscillating Turret config. Requires Sprocket Oscillating Turret.</description>
</Part>
